title: Filipino Cream Fritters
description: Crispy, fluffy, and utterly addictive Filipino cream fritters made with double cream, madeira cake, and a hint of coconut. A delightful vegan-friendly treat that's sure to impress.

ingredients.name: Double cream
ingredients.notes: Chilled in the fridge before use.

ingredients.name: Coconut milk
ingredients.notes: Full-fat coconut milk for a richer taste.

ingredients.name: Desiccated coconut
ingredients.notes: Toasted in a 350°F oven for 5-7 minutes.

ingredients.name: Vegan egg replacement
ingredients.notes: Flaxseed or chia seeds mixed with 2 tablespoons of water.

ingredients.name: Whipped cream
ingredients.notes: For topping, 1 cup chilled heavy whipping cream or dairy-free alternative.

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the chilled double cream, madeira cake crumbs, coconut milk, desiccated coconut, granulated sugar, salt, lemon zest, and vegan egg replacement until smooth.
